_meta.note: payload is the unmodified JSON response; data/bench/*.json is gitignored in the repo, so the API is the only source

standings.method: Bradley-Terry MAP, one fit (Gaussian prior sd 2.0 per log-strength), draws = half wins; 95% CI = 2.5/97.5 percentiles of 300 bootstrap resamples of games

cpu:9.label: CPU 9
cpu:9.about: Melee's built-in level-9 CPU. The anchor: pinned at 1500.

phillip:silver.label: Phillip silver
phillip:silver.about: slippi-ai (vladfi1) imitation + RL policy, silver tier; 18-24 frame built-in reaction delay.

phillip:plat.label: Phillip plat
phillip:plat.about: slippi-ai (vladfi1) imitation + RL policy, platinum tier; 18-24 frame built-in reaction delay.

phillip:gm.label: Phillip gm
phillip:gm.about: slippi-ai (vladfi1) imitation + RL policy, grandmaster tier; 18-24 frame built-in reaction delay.

hal:MASTER.label: HAL master
hal:MASTER.about: HAL: 250M transformer imitating human replays, conditioned on the master rank.

mimic.label: MIMIC fox
mimic.about: MIMIC: 20M transformer behaviour clone, Fox checkpoint.

faynt.label: Faynt 10M
faynt.about: Faynt 10M-Arena: transformer policy RL-tuned on Fox (runs on the CPU).

reyn.label: Reyn
reyn.about: Reyn-26C: language-steerable 33M policy, here with no command. The body every coach steers.

baseline:laser.label: Script laser

coach:random.label: Random coach
coach:random.about: Control: a uniformly random Reyn command every 5 s, no model.

llm_paused:random.label: Random macros
llm_paused:random.about: Control: the LLM player's macro set with a uniformly random macro at every decision, no model.

llm_live:random.label: Random macros, live

llm_live:none.label: Live fallback only
llm_live:none.about: Control: what a live LLM does while it waits for a reply (dash dance, shield when threatened), all game, no model.

human:mateo.label: Mateo

coach:random,fixed.label: Random coach, one command
coach:random,fixed.about: One random command, set at the start and held all game.

coach:random,sticky.label: Random coach, sticky
coach:random,sticky.about: A random command, changed on a quarter of the calls (Jev's effective change rate).

coach:random,jev6.label: Random coach, Jev's top 6
coach:random,jev6.about: A random pick every 5 s among the six commands Jev holds most (or none).

coach_jev,features.label: Jev coach + features
coach_jev,features.about: Jev every 5 s, with named features computed in code (distance, states, percent bands, last window).
